title: Xuất báo cáo chẩn đoán đã lọc dữ liệu riêng

baseline.note: origin/main includes merged Local AI diagnostics and setup (#34). The checkout branch was inspected without changing it. Recheck origin/main before creating a separate diagnostics PR.

goal: Produce a small local-only, versioned JSON report a user can inspect and explicitly copy to support a developer, without including private configuration, logs or content.

scope.navigation: Full Windows dashboard > Cài đặt > Chung > Báo cáo chẩn đoán; never exposed by the OCR/grammar/translation quick window.
scope.v1_delivery: Explicit preview, explicit Copy JSON, explicit Clear preview. No save-file dependency for v1. If Save JSON is wanted later, use a user-initiated platform save dialog with a fixed suggested filename and exactly the same preview bytes; do not accept an arbitrary filesystem path from renderer IPC.
scope.excluded: Automatic collection/upload; files/bundles; existing logs/config/cache; saved provider/model/address; live or last check results; filesystem presence inspection; clipboard reads; attachment sending; repro capture; fingerprinting; changes to settings or external state.
scope.performance: No page-load work, polling/timers, runtime probes, filesystem/registry access, subprocesses, model loading, audio/microphone/capture, HTTP calls or downloads. Preview reads only fixed build metadata and one bounded in-process status.

native: Use a dedicated module (e.g. diagnostics_export.rs) with typed structs and finite enums, a small versioned schema and stable field order. Explicitly construct each field. Never stringify, spread, recursively redact or forward whole Value objects, including Core::state(), setup::status(), local_ai_settings(), live_state or tool results.

Add dedicated native diagnostics_export_preview for the bundled full dashboard only. In .with_ipc_handler, require raw envelope property a to actually be a JSON array of length zero before the shared existing conversion that defaults malformed/missing arguments to []; reject missing, null, scalar/object, nonempty or other malformed args and quick windows without any work. Method accepts no paths/commands and returns only the typed allowlist; decoding/serialization errors use a fixed safe code without echoing inputs.

Read only compile-time build data: the exact numeric version core X.Y.Z (each field 1-5 ASCII decimal digits, no leading zeros except 0), otherwise fixed unknown. Never echo invalid values or prerelease/build metadata. Use compile-time OS-family, architecture and release/debug enums. No hostname, OS build, edition or registry/system inspection.

Expose a narrow read-only accessor returning the full dashboard native process’s most recently recorded Local AI setup event as typed coarse setup history. Do not call setup::status(), create/test its cross-process mutex, or inspect processes, paths, filesystem or environment. Map finite native stages and fixed failure kinds; omit raw exit codes, command lines and error strings. not_observed means no setup event recorded in this process, not that another process is idle. ready describes a prior setup event reporting tag/metadata readiness, not current availability, inference, or proof of weights.

Do not read or load any config, even for a seemingly harmless provider enum: no Core::cfg(), local_ai_settings(), config::load_config(), or profile enumeration. Do not enrich report from general Local AI Check/List/Test or quick bridge state. Omit model capabilities and last-check data in v1; any future phase must use an explicit full-dashboard-only snapshot and invalidate it mechanically against exact saved config revision before being considered. Preview never resolves redirected APPDATA/LOCALAPPDATA paths.

Omit all component-file presence checks in v1. No Path::exists(), metadata, directory traversal, reparse points/junctions, UNC/mapped filesystems or installed-package/process inspections. Do not report install detection from guesses.
Hold a conservative UTF-8 cap (max 4 KiB) on serialized JSON; fixed error if violated. No writes (config, logs, persistent preview, temp files or telemetry).
renderer: Place a compact Settings > Chung card: notice that text, prompt, accounts, paths and logs are not included, nothing is sent, and the user should read the preview before sharing it. Buttons: Xem báo cáo, Sao chép JSON, Xóa xem trước.

Only Xem báo cáo calls native generation. An input object is untrusted until every nested record is a plain object with only the exact required own data keys; reject unexpected prototypes, arrays, inherited properties, symbols, accessors and malformed/oversized values. Verify primitive types, finite enum values and exact bounded numeric version grammar. Reconstruct a fresh literal record in approved key order; never stringify raw native input. Serialize capped UTF-8, render the approved string in a read-only textarea or textContent (never HTML), and copy those exact reviewed bytes rather than regenerating or copying DOM selections.

Copy disabled until a valid preview exists. Clear removes in-memory and DOM preview and immediately disables copy; it does not read/erase the OS clipboard or undo a Copy already requested. Reset on leaving Settings/Chung and use a UI request revision to prevent late preview after clear/route change. Operation and errors have keyboard-accessible status text; no sensitive exception strings or auto-copy.

Use accessible keyboard focus, visible action statuses, and localized Vietnamese labels; treat Clipboard errors as local failures with manual select/copy still available. Changing view, refreshing usage, or launching a quick popup never generates the report.

app.version: exact numeric X.Y.Z, each 1-5 ASCII decimal digits, no leading zeros except 0; otherwise literal unknown. No echo, prerelease/build metadata, SHA, host/URL or path.

never_emit: User/host/account/profile/device/installation/session identifiers, window handles/PIDs, paths, filenames from disk, directories and environment values
Tokens, credentials, account data, email, usage metrics, hooks per profile, existing clipboard, raw config/cache/state/logs, exact timestamps, GUIDs and raw OS/process/network error or exit strings
Local endpoint, URL, IP, port, model ID/tag/weight hash, custom prompt, input/output/result text, screenshot/OCR data, audio/caption/transcript, device selections or meeting activity
Any unknown bridge keys/values or additional schema fields without independent privacy review
Saved provider configuration, last Local AI check or capabilities, filesystem/component presence and path-derived data. Do not add these to v1.

acceptance: Advisor confirms preview uses compile-time metadata and only a typed in-process setup projection, rejects whole config/state reads, probes and general check hooks, and stays in a separate PR.

Rust unit tests assert exact serialized key set, deterministic order, strict version grammar and limit, and coarse enums for all or unknown setup stages. not_observed is scoped to this dashboard process.

Adversarial synthetic fixtures inject private sentinels, fake/large settings/cache/log paths, hostile strings/types and malicious API results; no sentinels or unapproved keys are emitted/logged. Prove those sources are not called, rather than relying on removing dangerous fields after collection.

Native source-boundary review and tests verify the bridge touches no cfg/local_ai_settings/config::load_config/usage cache, no filesystem/registry or presence probes, no general Local AI Check/List/Test hook or quick worker, no network, no cross-process setup mutex, no start/capture/clipboard or writes.

Direct IPC fixture covers raw missing a, null, nonarray, nonempty array, and quick mode; no denied request collects data or causes any operation. Expected shim [] works. Stage/reason derive only from the fixed native projection; unknown values map safely or fail closed.

Real native Windows WebView2 test opens Settings > Chung and exercises actual native preview. No generation occurs on navigation. Report is inert, contains exact keys and known values, and copy matches displayed bytes only after a click.

JS fixture mocks clipboard and checks no automatic write/read, render/copy/clear, regeneration after clear, no promise that Clear undoes an already requested Copy, graceful clipboard denial, route changes, stale async reply, and malicious bridge payloads (HTML, unknown enums, extra/inherited/accessor keys, malformed/oversized values): no execution or copy.

Confirm existing Settings saves, Local AI Check/List/Test/setup, Cleaner shared Settings layout and quick popup behavior are unchanged. Generating/copying creates no extra probes in existing views and never starts a helper.
Independent Advisor privacy review on exact candidate, including native and renderer allowlist checks with hostile fixture evidence.
Pass Rust tests, hosted/native Windows WebView2 and full Windows regression plus extracted-package smoke when available. Record exact tested SHA, assertions and limits before expected-head merge.

Separate PR from other work. README explains the precise packet, historical per-process setup scope, copy-only/local behavior and that recorded readiness is not a statement about current availability or inference.

advisor_revision.scope_change: Use compile-time app metadata and a typed in-process setup snapshot only. Omit saved provider, last Local AI check and all filesystem presence probes in v1.
advisor_revision.privacy_boundary: No Core::cfg(), local_ai_settings(), config::load_config(), file/registry scan, general Local AI worker/Check/List/Test hooks, or share/upload route anywhere in export generation.

pre_code_review.result: Independent Advisor approved the exact draft without config, filesystem, registry or cross-process data.
